no_adcom_quote.quote: Your application for ALIQOPA was not referred to an FDA advisory committee because the application did not raise significant efficacy or safety issues for the proposed indication.

summary: No FDA advisory committee was convened for NDA209936 (ALIQOPA/copanlisib). The approval letter states the application was not referred to an advisory committee because it did not raise significant efficacy or safety issues for the proposed indication, and the administrative correspondence records 'No AC meeting.' Consequently there are no AdComm-driven linkages to the approval.
